summary: Backend developer with an IT degree and 5 years in debt collections operations, including leading a team of 10-12 collectors. Building Python and FastAPI APIs informed by hands-on skip-tracing and recovery work. Seeking a backend developer role in Toronto; open to relocation and US remote.

work.title: Team Lead, Collections
highlights: Collect $100K+ CAD per month in outstanding debt through outbound calls to debtors
Lead a team of 10-12 collectors: manage performance, train and onboard new hires
Design collection strategies based on market conditions to meet collection goals
Conduct skip tracing from publicly available data, storing results in a reusable format and analyzing the data
Coordinate with law firms, litigators, and lenders on account recovery

education.institution: I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (formerly Punjab Technical University)

projects.name: Skiptracer
projects.subtitle: Skip-tracing API for debt collection
highlights: Building a FastAPI backend that lets collectors search for debtors across Canadian public platforms, based on my skip-tracing work in collections
Implemented JWT authentication (register and login) and protected routes using FastAPI dependency injection
Built search endpoints with Pydantic validation and PostgreSQL persistence through SQLAlchemy; search history and lookups are scoped to the authenticated user
In progress: Google Custom Search integration, email pattern inference with MX verification, and confidence scoring
